title: Cosmic Visionary
description: A bald woman with glowing markings on her head emerges from a swirling cosmic vortex. Her torso dissolves into a colorful nebula filled with fish, flowers, and geometric patterns, set against a dramatic landscape of jagged mountains under a radiant sun with radiating beams.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a bald woman with luminous markings on her scalp, emerging from a swirling galaxy vortex. Her body transitions into a colorful nebula containing fish, flowers, and intricate sacred geometry patterns including a large circular mandala behind her. Jagged dark mountains with red highlights sit in the foreground, while a bright sun with dramatic radiating beams shines in the upper right. Psychedelic color palette with vibrant purples, teals, and golds, detailed linework, fantasy illustration style.
